versions.changelog: Round 24: deep fragmentation analysis and redundancy governance

Piper TTS Lite v1.0.0 — First Release

- Provides local neural TTS with Piper, using the default English male voice (en_US-kusal-medium).
- Converts short text into MP3 voice messages, fully local processing—no cloud use, no API keys needed.
- Includes quick setup scripts for dependency installation and voice synthesis.
- Supports command-line MP3 output and integration with platforms like Telegram or Discord.
- Limitations: single voice only, no long-text segmentation, no batch/SSML/style features (see paid version for upgrades).
